comparison.objective: Disinfect an IV connector for 15 seconds, then attach and operate a flush syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed frictional wiping, contamination-aware sequencing, fine connector alignment, and plunger actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Full 15 s scrub precedes any syringe contact; syringe is centered/seated and the required plunger stroke completed.
comparison.reason: Timed cleaning and sterile operation sequencing differ from bearing-block transfer, despite a shared fine insertion primitive.
